_comment: Example phrases for the launcher's search by meaning (Launcher.qml, Semantic.qml). Each phrase between commas, colons or periods is matched on its own against what you type. actions: by action id; apps: by app key (app:<desktop id>); shortcuts: by what the niri bind runs (niri <action> [args], or the program and its arguments). Edit freely; changed phrases are re-embedded the next time the launcher opens.
